parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The fleet ID. You can call the [DescribeHubClusters](~~424404~~) operation to obtain the IDs of created fleet instances.

parameters.name: ClusterIds
parameters.description:
The array of IDs for the child clusters to remove from the fleet. You can call the [DescribeManagedClusters](~~424408~~) operation to obtain the IDs of child clusters that are added to the fleet.

The value is a JSON string that can be parsed into a string array.

parameters.name: DetachFromMesh
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove the child cluster only from the Service Mesh (ASM) instance.

- true: Removes the child cluster only from the ASM instance.

- false: Removes the child cluster from both the ASM instance and ACK One.

If this parameter is not set, the default value is **false**. The child cluster is removed from both the ASM instance and ACK One.
